features.title: Schwarzschild black hole, accretion disk and geodesic camera
Impacts: ejecta that become ground, fractures from a body, the density of water
Pyro: a window that follows the plume, and blasts
Multiple scattering in media, and foam in the water's albedo
Voxel assets, objects of cells and their physics
Documentation of SREP 40 attributes (no change of meaning)
